summary.t: Gingerbread houses - little charms for a Merry Christmas

text.t:
Delicately laser-cut from pine plywood, these three gingerbread houses stand out with their charming details and the Merry Christmas inscription, celebrating the magic of this special season.
A delicate wavy silver ribbon adds a touch of sparkle and elegance, enhancing the natural beauty of the wood.
Small ornaments, designed to give your Christmas tree a timeless and cosy charm.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: This is an ornament and not a toy: hang it out of reach of small children, who may put it in their mouths.
